Create a working example and documentation to guide users in creating custom modules aligned with recommended development practices.
Implement a sink module to write data into a Kafka broker, allowing mass data publishing, including configuration and testing.
Resolve the XD-2015 issue where running grunt test:e2e fails with a socket hang up error, allowing tests and server to run together in one process.

Perform end-to-end integration testing of all new features and bug fixes, and prepare the deployment artifacts.
